g.text: • Drag each label from the word bank
to its correct position on the flower
• Match the 10 flower parts to their
• Use the Hint button if you need help
• Click Check Answer to verify your work
Word Bank - Drag Labels to Match Flower Parts
1. Petals - Colorful parts that attract pollinators (pink/red)
2. Sepals - Green leaf-like parts protecting the bud
5. Anther - Top part of stamen that produces pollen
7. Ovary - Base of pistil containing ovules
8. Style - Tube connecting stigma to ovary
9. Stigma - Top of pistil that receives pollen
10. Receptacle - Base where flower parts attach
Tip: Start with the most obvious parts first!
✓ Petals should be on the colorful outer parts
✓ Sepals are the green protective leaves
✓ Receptacle is at the base of the flower
Are you sure you want to reset?
All your label placements will be cleared.
